args.prompt:
Create a new KFB soft claymation ink blob sprite sheet, The Domestic Watch Desk. Fictional political satire about roles and procedures. The original image inputs guide organic full-body dark charcoal-plum blob forms and sculpted face construction. Exactly six unique independent standalone complete footless ink blobs, three columns by two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Faces sculpted directly in continuous goo with thick dark filled eyelids, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Give each a different compact curved body shape, varying natural lower edges and soft attached side lobes. Mix narrow tapered ends, round curves and irregular splats. No standardized foot base, humanoid torso, long jackets, necks, separate legs or shoes. Wear only a tiny pin, glasses, short tab or narrow band if needed. Keep each prop close to the upper belly or side and preserve the complete body outline. Tiny dark ink hands. Smooth satin clay, sparse broad hand marks, clean glass and soft fabric folds. No dense stipple. Teeth behind lips. Clear gutters, no scenery, shadow disc, stage, frame, typography, branding, party or official national insignia. Strongly varied expressive moods and recognizable small tools. Graphite, muted moss and old amber. Compact analytical tools, fictional emblems and blank documents.
Row-major roles:
1. Female-read fictional redaction analyst. upright reverse comma, focused downturned eyes and tight lips. Key cue: one little black roller passing over a blank cream card with two broad bars.
2. Male-read fictional domestic intelligence researcher. broad low splat, puzzled angled eyes and small frown. Key cue: palm-sized board with three large removable dots and one thick connecting cord.
3. Male-read fictional observation desk officer. tall tapered body, alert sideways eyes and closed pout. Key cue: small hand-held binoculars held away from the face.
4. Male-read fictional secure records clerk. round irregular bean, droopy eyelids and wary little smile. Key cue: tiny smooth lock attached to a plain file case.
5. Female-read fictional constitutional safeguards reviewer. wide asymmetric curled blob, steady serious eyes and slightly parted lips. Key cue: short magnifier over a small blank rulebook with one clear colored tab.
6. Male-read fictional internal review officer. short soft diamond splat, suspicious raised eyebrow and tight crooked grin. Key cue: small wooden stamp with a sculpted loop arrow and an unmarked card.
Use six clearly differentiated expressions, props and silhouettes. Render every figure complete with clear alpha separation.
